The edits in this cell behave like components in parallel and series paths: whether one change helps depends on what already sits on a neighbouring edge. Three fields study the same kind of context-dependent effect.

1. **Electrical circuits:** whether adding or changing an element helps depends on whether a parallel bypass already exists. This is like a skip edge shunting a path.
2. **Ecology:** whether a species adds function depends on which species already fill that role. This is like a convolution edit being redundant when an equivalent op sits on a parallel edge.
3. **Hydrology:** whether a new connection between channels improves flow depends on whether the routes already in place carry it, much as Braess-type effects make an added link help or hurt depending on the existing topology.
